title: Austin: Sidewalks, Taxes, and Speeding Fines
summary:
*   **Infrastructure & Paving:** Authorized bids for new concrete sidewalks and curbing on West 22nd Street. Also approved a request to sublet excavation work for the West 8th Street paving project, requiring the subcontractor to provide an indemnity bond.
*   **Taxation & Finance:** Approved a new tax collector for the city. The council also adjusted a citizen's 1913 property improvement tax assessment, reducing it from $600 to $400.
*   **Traffic Enforcement:** Remitted speeding fines for two individuals, H.A. Wree and Mrs. M. Robertson.

March 28th 1914:
Councilman Powell offered the following resolution: Be it resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin: That whereas, the City of Austin has entered into a contract with
Texas Bitulithic Company by the terms of which Texas Bitulithic Company is to pave West
8th street in said City between Congress Avenue and Colorado street ; and Whereas, said
Texas Bitulithic company desires to sublet the work of excavating said portion of said
street which is necessarily incident to the paving thereof under said contract ; and
Jex. Bitulithic Co.

Whereas , it is deemed advisable by the City Council of Austin that the subletting of said
portion of said contract should be consented to by the City of Austin provided that
subcontractor to whom said excavation work is sublet shall enter into a good and
suffi-cient bond satisfactory to said Texas Bitulithic Company , indemnifying the City of
Austin and said Company against any and all liability for damages occasioned by his
employees and all other persons and property by reason of any negligence in the
preformance of said excavation work ;

Now, therefore, it is hereby resolved by the City of Austin that the consent of said City
be and is hereby given to the subletting of said portion of said contract on the
conditions above expressed.

The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Woolridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
